meta.title: Radiation Absorbed Dose Converter — Convert Gray and More
meta.description: Free radiation absorbed dose converter for 5+ units including Gray, Milligray, Microgray. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Gray, rad. Convert between 5 radiation absorbed dose units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for radiation absorbed dose in this tool is **Gy**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most radiation absorbed dose conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this radiation absorbed dose converter?
**A:** It uses 5 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Gray (Gy), Milligray (mGy), Microgray (µGy), Rad (rad), Millirad (mrad).
